verdict.rationale: Docs mention that high-end GPU types like H100 require requesting approval to use them, implying some quota/limit gating exists, but there is no documented quota dashboard, no explicit numeric limits per account, and no defined process for requesting general capacity increases beyond this one mention. missing for 10: documented quota/limit tables, self-service or ticketed quota-increase process, SLA/turnaround for approval requests, and any independent confirmation this process works.
